answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, slashed on a failed audit, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the delta of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. A quartz of per-task receipts records who did what, and the canyon of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
